result: Exact rmcp-v3.1.4 TaskManager pins per-task input-key uniqueness in used_input_keys and accepts partial tasks/update sets by removing only currently pending keys; absent duplicate/already-answered/superseded keys on a known task are ignored, while unknown taskId is INVALID_PARAMS. The smallest restart-safe persistence rule is a never-reused per-key tombstone with monotonic PENDING->ANSWERED(response)->APPLIED and PENDING->INVALIDATED transitions. ANSWERED must retain the response payload until durable operation progress proves application, otherwise a crash after protocol acceptance but before consumption loses accepted input. Cancellation invalidates still-PENDING keys before ack; restart must never reopen ANSWERED/APPLIED/INVALIDATED as PENDING and may redeliver ANSWERED only to the authoritative attempt/generation.
